name: CineStream
description: One stop solution for Movies, Series, Anime, AsianDrama and Torrents (includes CineAnime: AniList + TMDB + AnimePahe). v520: single-instance Cloudflare bypass dialog, device WebView User-Agent (consistent with Client Hints and with request headers) and saved solver UA, so the challenge stops reloading. Still keeps the manual Save Cookies + Close UI and auto-popup on launch when no cookies are saved. Includes movie fix (v505), rate limit caching (v506), Simkl covers (v507), TMDB logo any-language fallback (v510), fanart.tv logo fallback (v512), TMDB backdrop middle layer (v511).
